description_en: Assigns a gateway to an edge instance
description_zh: 将网关分配到边缘实例中
name: BindGatewayToEdgeInstance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the Edge Instances page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The key of the product to which the gateway belongs. The key is the unique identifier of the product.

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName
parameters.help_zh:
网关所属产品的Key，产品的唯一标识符。

如果传入此参数，需同时传入DeviceName
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the gateway device.

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
网关设备名称。

如果传入此参数，需同时传入ProductKey
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the gateway device. This is the unique identifier generated by IoT Platform for the device. It corresponds one-to-one with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName.

If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with the ProductKey and DeviceName combination, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
网关设备的ID，物联网平台为设备生成的唯一标识符，与ProductKey和DeviceName组合一一对应。

如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName；如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

Code.description_en: The response code. Success indicates success. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
